item.title: Workers' remittances rise year-on-year in October, SBP data shows
item.description: Remittances sent home by overseas Pakistanis rose year-on-year in October, according to State Bank of Pakistan data, with the Gulf the largest source.

item.title: Freelance export payments to be credited faster, SBP says
item.description: Banks must now credit freelancers' export proceeds within one working day under a new SBP circular.
